text:
Sam (Partnerships): Heads-up: vendors circulated preliminary ship windows for H200 revA, B200 firmware refresh, MI300-XL, and Gaudi2 pre-release. We need coordinated embargo planning + marketplace handoff.

Rina (HW Ops): Do we have any firm dates? Vendors say: H200June window, MI300-XL late-July, Gaudi2 pilot mid-July. B200 fw might slip depending on validation.

Jorge (Marketplace): Marketplace needs 6-8 weeks to prep images, pricing, and support docs. If H200 target is mid-June, we should lock artifacts by early May.

Priya (SI): SI onboarding = compatibility matrix + two perf runs. If we parallelize some validation we could cut ~1 week, but still need driver/firmware access ASAP.

Sam (Partnerships): Proposed immediate items before vendor sync: 1) Request signed manifests + early driver drop, 2) Draft embargo windows, 3) Marketplace asset checklist. Meeting tomorrow 9am PT to align?

Rina (HW Ops): Added vendor PMs to calendar. Also: flag dependency -- B200 fw depends on vendor test harness which they may not hand over until GA. Could block our validation.

Jorge (Marketplace): Quick timeline draft:
```
- Day 0: vendor final binaries + signed manifest
- Day 7: marketplace image build & metadata
- Day 21: SI perf round 1
- Day 35: SI perf round 2 + legal review
- Day 42: marketing embargo lift / public announcement
```

Priya (SI): That works if Day 0 driver arrives. If driver is delayed >3 days we shift everything. Also request nightly image access for perf harness.

legal-bot: Reminder: External partner announcements require at least 72 hours legal review and a compliance checklist completed.

Sam (Partnerships): Action items: Rina -> ask vendors for early driver and manifest. Jorge -> post marketplace checklist (image spec, price bands, SKUs). Priya -> perf thresholds & test harness links. I'll coordinate vendor sync agenda.

Rina (HW Ops): Noted. I'll also ask vendor for firmware changelog and known issues.

Jorge (Marketplace): One question: do we prefer per-SKU pricing in marketplace or a single family with variant labels? Per-SKU simplifies billing for customers.

Priya (SI): Per-SKU is preferred for clear perf guarantees. Will confirm with finance.

Sam (Partnerships): Thanks all. I'll capture this summary in the invite and aim to have embargo windows agreed by EOD Friday. Please flag any blackout dates for June 8-19. :calendar:
